coverage_exempt.reason: Early return after the test of the 0x46bcf0 result: 0x46bcf0 has a single exit that loads 1 into eax (read in the disassembly), so the branch to 0x46bcba is always taken and this return cannot execute.

Branch for a zero-length string after truncation: the code only reaches it past a check that the length is at least 5 and then removes 4 characters, so the length is at least 1 and the compare against 1 never fails (read in the disassembly).
